note: After searching ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web, Okfuskee County and its main cities (Okemah, Henryetta, Paden) publish no queryable zoning district polygon service. Henryetta says zoning is not yet adopted; Okemah's zoning map is on file with the city clerk, not online; the only zoning-attribute data found is Regrid's commercial parcel store, which is not an official service.
